# Project instructions

## Python
- Use Python 3.12.
- Prefer NumPy and PyTorch.
- Avoid unnecessary Python loops.
- Vectorize numerical operations whenever possible.
- Use type hints.
- Use pytest for tests.

## Code quality
- Keep functions small and focused.
- Do not modify public APIs without explicit instruction.
- Explain non-obvious mathematical operations.

## Robotics
- Coordinate conventions must be documented.
- Use SI units.
- Angles are in radians.
